purpose: Post-review corrected-target count-distribution comparison; not a new blind confirmation or a reopening of representation selection

models.count_distribution_candidate: NB2 regression with log link, jointly optimized dispersion, standardized B features, no coefficient penalty
models.count_distribution_reference: Poisson regression with log link, standardized B features, no coefficient penalty
models.exceedance_reference: Logistic regression with standardized B features, C=1.0, L2, seed 1701

main_text_gate.scope: dataset-specific; KBTP confirmation and KAGC are adjudicated separately
main_text_gate.count_distribution: NB2 group-equal NLL < Poisson group-equal NLL
main_text_gate.exceedance: NB2 group-equal Brier or log loss < Logistic at the frozen q75 threshold
main_text_gate.direction: strict majority of source groups on the relevant evaluation set

claim_boundary: The outcome is an ADS-B-derived geometric interaction-onset count, not controller workload, certified separation loss, accident probability, or universal airspace complexity.
